sections.body: We will start with Session Zero, move into the delivery job, follow the route through escalating complications, and take breaks so the table can breathe.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: We will start with Session Zero, move into the delivery job, follow the route through escalating complications, and take breaks so the table can breathe.

sections.title: Player bullets
items: Session Zero: safety, rules, characters, and connections.
Opening contract: the sealed delivery and why you took the job.
Road trouble: the route proves less safe than advertised.
Hush and investigation: meet people, ask questions, and decide who to trust.
Final pressure: the delivery becomes a choice, not just a job.
Breaks: short five-minute pauses as needed, plus a longer midpoint break if the table wants it.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Orient players to the act structure, pacing, and break policy.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Script: Give players the shape of the night without spoiling the story. Explain that the Run Clock will remind you to check in for five-minute breaks and a possible longer midpoint break.
Keep the pacing overview high-level. Do not spoil act twists.
Use the Run Clock break prompts as a reminder to ask the table, not as a mandatory interruption.
Checklist: Act shape explained; Break policy explained; Run Clock break reminders enabled

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Give players the shape of the night without spoiling the story. Explain that the Run Clock will remind you to check in for five-minute breaks and a possible longer midpoint break.
